messages:
rachel: spotted a small ripple in invoice-preview for routes using new sticky-resolve policy at 09:12 UTC. looks like +0.4% token delta for a few tenants :thinking:
omar: saw that in the telemetry heatmap. preview delta clusters by resolver_version=v2-sticky and session_id churn.
ciaran: quick hypothesis: resolver returns a transient route_version field that changed mid-request, causing preview to count two attributions (old+new). our dedupe key is still only request_id.
deploy-bot: rollout 1769923343 to resolver-service (v2-sticky) completed at 09:10 UTC.
rachel: ok timing lines up. can we pull a sample of the two events for one request_id?
omar: fetching logs, example:
```
{"request_id":"r-abc123","route_version":"v1","fingerprint":"fpX"}
{"request_id":"r-abc123","route_version":"v2","fingerprint":"fpX"}
```
same fingerprint, different route_version. both hit preview consumer.
ciaran: two options: 1) make preview dedupe include (request_id,fingerprint,route_version) OR 2) prefer final route_version only and treat transient flips as telemetry. i prefer option 2 for correctness.
billing: if we keep previews as-is we'll show small positive deltas to customers. we should hold auto-apply for affected tenants until dedupe/backfill runs.
rachel: mitigation: pause route-version rollout to 0% (omar?), and add a short consumerside rule: ignore events where route_version_age < 5s and another event for same fingerprint appears within 10s. cheap debounce until we patch.
omar: toggled rollout gate to 0% at 09:15 UTC. implementing debounce in preview consumer now, will push a canary.
ciaran: follow-up: update the counting contract in the metering API: require "final_delivery" enum for billing increments; interim attributions go to telemetry only. i'll open a tiny RFC.
billing: good. also request a dashboard card "preview-delta by resolver_version" and an alert if >0.25% over 5m.
rachel: created ticket ENGPLAT-9786 to track debounce, RFC, and billing hold, assigning to ciaran+omar. will paste tenant list in the ticket. :thumbsup:
